chapters.title: Welcome to flask
chapters.subtitle: What it is, how it's laid out, and how to run it
chapters.intro:
**pallets/flask**: A simple framework for building complex web applications.

Flask is a lightweight [WSGI] web application framework. It is designed to make getting started quick and easy, with the ability to scale up to complex applications. It began as a simple wrapper around [Werkzeug] and [Jinja], and has become one of the most popular Python web application frameworks.

narrative.text: Flask is the central object in the Pallets Flask project, implementing a WSGI application. It provides methods like `ensure_sync`, `async_to_sync`, and `update_template_context` to manage the application's lifecycle. The `Config` class allows for flexible configuration management, and the `Request` object is used to handle incoming requests.
